resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1925 on the Forest Service, firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; 1923 or 1924 in a 1977 newspaper item and Rex's own 1923 timeline. The story gives both.

The Wikipedia table gives a June 5, 1975 listing and an October 17, 1983 delisting. The NRHP index page says added 1983. The 1977 article calling it recently recorded in the National Register fits the 1975 date. The story reports the Wikipedia dates and the index page's conflicting year.
Lightning on firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts, the Forest Service and the Wikipedia table; a structural fire of unsure cause (lightning or vandalism) on Rex's page. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Four sources agree on the 1925 cabin and the 1983 loss, but the build year (1923-24 vs 1925) and the cause (lightning vs an unsure structural fire) conflict. The NRHP dates conflict between the Wikipedia table (1975 listing, 1983 delisting) and an NRHP index page (added 1983). The agency in the brief is corrected to Nez Perce National Forest, with Bitterroot until 1957. Access is set to public from the Selway-Bitterroot Wilderness and the hike-in label; no closure notice was found. A Forest Fire Lookout Association Facebook post about the site was not read, so the photo and site descriptions it may hold are not used.
